========================================
GNU extended asm with fused :: sections
========================================

void f(void) {
  __asm__ volatile("b code" ::: "memory");
  int out, in = 1;
  __asm__("mov %0, %1" : "=r"(out) : "r"(in) : "r0");
  __asm__ volatile("x" :: "i"(in), "j"(out) : "m1", "m2");
}

void g(void) {
  __asm__ goto("j" :::: done, fail);
done:
  return;
fail:
  return;
}

---

========================================
Fused sections: raw strings, concatenated clobbers, field names
========================================

void h(void) {
  __asm__ goto("" : : "r"(*x) :: done);
  __asm__ goto("x" :: "i"(a) : "memory" : done);
  __asm__("x" ::: R"(memory)" "sync");
done:
  return;
}

---

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (primitive_type))))
    (compound_statement
      (expression_statement
        (gnu_asm_expression
          (gnu_asm_qualifier)
          (string_literal)
          (gnu_asm_output_operand_list)
          (gnu_asm_input_operand_list
            (gnu_asm_input_operand
              (string_literal
                (string_content))
              (pointer_expression
                (identifier))))
          (gnu_asm_goto_list
            (identifier))))
      (expression_statement
        (gnu_asm_expression
          (gnu_asm_qualifier)
          (string_literal
            (string_content))
          (gnu_asm_input_operand_list
            (gnu_asm_input_operand
              (string_literal
                (string_content))
              (identifier)))
          (gnu_asm_clobber_list
            (string_literal
              (string_content)))

            (identifier))))

              (raw_string_literal
                (raw_string_content))
              (string_literal
                (string_content))))))
      (labeled_statement
        (statement_identifier)
        (return_statement)))))

================================================================================
Fused sections: trailing-identifier clobber macros
================================================================================

void f(void) {
  __asm__("x" ::: "xmm" XMM_INDEX);
}
